quest.title: The Art of Horticulture
quest.description: You have obtained a bag of Naku Weed seeds in Inazuma, but if you want to plant them in the Serenitea Pot, you might need to ask Madame Ping for some pointers...
quest.rewards_formatted: Seed Dispensary x1, Unknown Item #372502 x1

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These are... seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: These are Naku Weed seeds.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know about this plant?

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Well, I kind of know about it. I've seen this plant before and I've heard people talk about its wonders.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: I remember that... even in the absence of wind, this plant will tremble slightly to the sound of thunder...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does it look good when grown?

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: If we're talking about appearance alone... I daresay it looks rather nice indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Would you like to try growing some Naku Weeds? But I don't believe there to be any suitable land hereabouts...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have my own plot of land.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Oh, is that so? As expected of you... So, you have even been gifted land already?

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Pardon me for asking, but is your land...

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: #Oh! I have also heard tell of your feats in Mondstadt and Liyue, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: Indeed, it would be more surprising if you were not gifted land for such deeds!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, the land you're talking about is the Serenitea Pot that Granny gave us, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can you really grow things in there? Granny didn't say anything about it before...

choices.text: Let's go back and ask her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay then, let's go back and ask Granny.

choices.text: The adepti are very powerful after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is that so? But Granny really is very strong, so...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay then, let's go back and ask Granny.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: #A t—teapot? {F#Madam}{M#Sir}, please don't play such a joke on me.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: I have also heard tell of your feats in Mondstadt and Liyue.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: So I guess that your land is either in Liyue or in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hmm? Hello children, are you here to see me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Naku Weed seeds...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Seeds... Ah, so you'd like to grow these seeds in the Serenitea Pot?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: I suppose that's no problem. The Serenitea Pot is your little realm, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: It's just that you've only brought this bag of seeds today. Are you only planning to plant this one bag of seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that's right! We don't even know how to collect seeds...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After we plant this bag of seeds, where do we go to find more...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: There, there, don't worry. I happen to have a little box here that I used many years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: When I used to plant flowers, they were all kept in this little box. The flowers grown in the box can be preserved for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Moreover, after putting the flowers in the box, it can produce several flower seeds... This makes sowing them very convenient indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Although this box is somewhat less useful now... but it still retains the power to "generate seeds."

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hmm... I don't use it much now anyway... So, why don't I give it to you?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: This box should come in handy, whether you want to grow some flowers and plants, or some crops.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you, Granny!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank you, Granny!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh children, you don't have to be so polite. Go ahead and give it a try, but I must say that it's not an easy task to take care of flowers and plants, so you should be prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Granny is really powerful indeed... but before we try that box out, let's go back to our teapot and try to sow those seeds.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, Paimon really hopes that they'll grow soon...
